notes.title: Huge Playtest Update!!!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! 

We hope you guys are excited for our first big playtest update :3

If you also want to be a part of this journey, then please feel free to join our official Garden Ink Discord channel !

Please let us know about your thoughts!

With much love,
